name: nextjs-revalidate
description: Next.js plugin allows you to purge & re-build the cached pages from the WordPress admin area. It also automatically purges & re-builds when a page/post/... is save or updated.
author: superhuit <tech@superhuit.ch>

scripts.lint:php: php=${PHP_BIN:-php}; v=$($php -r 'echo PHP_MAJOR_VERSION.".".PHP_MINOR_VERSION;') || exit 1; [ "$v" = 7.4 ] || [ "${ALLOW_PHP_VERSION_MISMATCH:-}" = 1 ] || { echo "lint:php: $php is PHP $v, not 7.4 — a newer parser accepts PHP 8-only syntax and proves nothing. Point PHP_BIN at a 7.4 binary, or set ALLOW_PHP_VERSION_MISMATCH=1." >&2; exit 1; }; files=$(git ls-files '*.php') || exit 1; for f in $files; do $php -l "$f" || exit 1; done
